{npc:Rabaz}, in Farmine, has developed a great interest in plants and is writing a botany almanac about Zao. Take the {item:Botany Almanach}, collect samples of two rare plants, the {item:Giant Dreadcoil} and the {item:Giant Verminous}, with an {item:Obsidian Knife} and come back to receive the {item:Sedge Hat}, 1,000 gp and 3,000 experience. It is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales}.
Rabaz has taken an ambitious interest in plants. Maybe you can help him collect some samples.
or a melee weapon to cut the Spider Webs
The {item:Sedge Hat} you receive at the end is needed for the Sedge Hat addon.
This mission does **not** unlock Farmine's potion shop: that can only be done with the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
The samples do not show up as an item in your inventory. Confirm it by the orange text that appears above your character when you cut the plant.
Along the way in Zao you will meet several lesser creatures of the region: bring potions.
1. Accept the mission and get the almanac

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}. In Farmine, talk to {npc:Rabaz}: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Go to the warehouse **west** of the shop (the door next to it) and open the chest to receive the {item:Botany Almanach}. Make sure you have it in your inventory before continuing.
If you lose the almanac, Rabaz has to write another one and put it back in the chest, which takes time.
Leave Farmine for the Zao Steppe

In Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the elevator takes you to the mountain surface. Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
Go to the Lancer Beetle Cave
Leave Farmine for the {wiki:Zao Steppes} and look for the small {wiki:Lancer Beetle Cave}, to the **northwest**.

About halfway through the cave is the {item:Giant Dreadcoil}. Use the {item:Obsidian Knife} on it to collect the sample (orange text appears above your character). Then leave the cave the same way you came in.
The cave is full of {creature:Lancer Beetle|Lancer Beetles}.
Enter the Zao Wailing Widow Cave
Go to the {wiki:Zao Wailing Widow Cave}, a little **east** of {wiki:Zao Orc Land}.
Inside, go **northeast** to the {item:Spider Web|Spider Webs}. Use the {item:Fire Bug} or a melee weapon on the webs to get through.
Watch out for the {creature:Wailing Widow|Wailing Widows}.
Go **north** and follow the path **northwest** and then **northeast** to a big pit.

At the edge of the pit is the {item:Giant Verminous}. Use the {item:Obsidian Knife} on it and confirm the orange text. Then leave the cave the same way: go back through the webs (if they have returned, break them again) to the entrance ({coord:33223,31397,7}).
There is a {item:Giant Dreadcoil} very close to the Giant Verminous, but that one **does not work**: cut the Verminous itself.
The orange message when you collect the sample

On the steppe, return to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine. Later, to leave Farmine, talk to {npc:Thorgrin} at the Steamship: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.
Go back to {npc:Rabaz} in Farmine, say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to show him the almanac.
